# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of this project is supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/coliff/bootstrap-5-migrate-tool/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue for security reports.

We will acknowledge your report as soon as possible and work with you to understand and address the issue.
